projects.title: AquaFlow — Hydration Tracker
projects.problem: People frequently forget to drink enough water throughout the day, with no engaging way to build a lasting daily habit
projects.solution: Built a gamified hydration tracking web app with XP-based level progression (from 'Thirsty Noob' to 'Aqua God'), streak tracking, achievement badges, smart notification reminders, animated stats dashboard, and persistent local storage — all without a backend
projects.challenges: Implementing persistent state without a backend using localStorage, building smooth animations that feel rewarding, and designing a progression system genuinely engaging beyond just functional
projects.impact: Live web application with full gamification loop — level system, daily streaks, 10+ achievements, hydration reminders, and a real-time progress dashboard

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.problem: Needed a modern, interactive portfolio to effectively showcase skills, projects, and professional background to real employers and clients
projects.solution: Built a fully responsive single-page application using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS — featuring dark/light mode toggle, typewriter name animation, animated skill bars, project category filters, an integrated contact form, CV viewer, and GitHub/LinkedIn/WhatsApp integration
projects.challenges: Achieving seamless universal dark mode, animated typewriter reveal on every navigation, accessible contact form with email fallback, and consistent cross-device experience
projects.impact: Live professional portfolio hosted on Vercel — actively used to attract clients and job opportunities

projects.title: Lipana STK Push Payment System
projects.problem: Businesses using web apps lacked a seamless way to collect M-Pesa mobile money payments directly from customers
projects.solution: Built a complete full-stack M-Pesa Lipana STK Push integration: Python/Flask backend handles Daraja API authentication, STK Push initiation, real-time callback processing and transaction verification; React frontend displays live payment status with success/failure feedback and a clean checkout UI
projects.challenges: Handling async payment callbacks securely, implementing real-time status polling, protecting API credentials in a public-facing deployment, and managing cold-start latency on a free cloud tier
projects.impact: Live payment solution enabling seamless M-Pesa STK Push transactions from a web interface — demonstrates real-world backend integration, secure API design, and webhook verification

projects.title: Business Landing Website
projects.problem: A local business needed a professional online presence to showcase services and make it easy for customers to get in touch
projects.solution: Designed and developed a fully responsive multi-section business website — service listings, contact section, and branded visual identity — using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript with mobile-first design
projects.challenges: Delivering a visually consistent, performant site across all screen sizes while integrating branding assets and maintaining fast load times
projects.impact: Live website actively showcasing the client's services, building online credibility and driving customer enquiries

projects.title: Identity Rebrand Project
projects.problem: Small local businesses lacked professional digital branding, making it hard to compete and appear credible online
projects.solution: Created comprehensive digital branding packages for multiple clients — custom logos, colour palettes, typography systems, brand guidelines, and social media assets
projects.challenges: Translating each client's personality and business values into a cohesive visual identity that works across print and digital contexts
projects.impact: Delivered professional brand identities for multiple small businesses, improving their online presence and client perception

projects.title: Web Vulnerability Assessment
projects.problem: Web applications are frequently exposed to common threats such as XSS, SQL injection, and insecure endpoints
projects.solution: Conducted structured security audits on test web applications using Burp Suite to intercept, analyse, and probe HTTP traffic — identifying and documenting OWASP Top 10 vulnerability classes
projects.challenges: Methodically identifying vulnerabilities without disrupting system functionality and producing actionable remediation reports
projects.impact: Identified critical XSS and SQL injection vectors, produced documented findings with severity ratings and clear recommendations for developers
